messages.subject: 3 modeling Post Doc positions in Switzerland
parts:
Good morning,

 

The Swiss Ornithological Institute is offering three postdoc positions in the areas of statistical modelling of bird abundance and distribution changes, ecological interactions and population dynamics.

One of them might be particularly interesting for the hmecology audience - it is about developing integrated population models for bird populations and will be supervised by Marc Kéry and me.

See the attachment for details on all of the offered positions.

Thank you for spreading.

 

Kind regards

 

Michael Schaub
